normative_extracts.spec_section: 10.5 Proxy Object Internal Methods and Internal Slots
normative_extracts.quote: A Proxy exotic object intercepts internal methods such as [[Get]], [[Set]], and [[HasProperty]] via user-supplied handler traps.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Proxy replaces ordinary object internal slots with exotic traps that bypass V8 Inline Caches and enforce target invariants via Reflect.

production_failures.symptom: TypeError: Cannot read private member #x from an object whose class did not declare it
production_failures.root_cause: Calling a class method through a Proxy passes the Proxy as 'this' (Receiver), which lacks the target's internal private-field slot.
production_failures.mitigation: Bind methods to the underlying target in the get trap or avoid wrapping classes with private fields in Proxies.

production_failures.symptom: 50x slowdown in tight numerical array loops
production_failures.root_cause: Wrapping hot data arrays in reactive Proxies bypasses V8 Inline Caches and executes JS trap functions on every index read.
production_failures.mitigation: Mark large immutable/numerical collections as raw (e.g. shallow/non-proxied) before entering tight loops.
